items.text: Dear Mood Confectioners,

We just pushed out a patch for v1.0.8 the other night, which should fix several more issues that were reported over the past days. It's another long list of fixes, and we’re deeply grateful for your patience while our team worked through them.

We’re continuing to monitor the Steam forums and our Discord server, and while we may not be able to respond to every report, rest assured that we’re doing our best to resolve any new issues as quickly as possible. 🙏
\ Rebalanced and reduced the appearance rate of customers whose stories have already been completed.
\ Rebalanced customer appearance rates to further favor eligible customers over other customers whose arcs are currently unable to progress.
\ Rebalanced and reduced cases where recently unseen eligible characters continued to be skipped.
\ Made tweaks and improved the selection balance between arc scenes vs regular donut orders.
\ Fixed several issues involving flower stencil and drizzle scoring behavior.
\ Fixed several issues involving powdered sugar and topping evaluation.
\ Fixed random or empty color tags appearing in recipe and dialogue text.
\ Fixed recipe descriptions not processing ingredient and formatting tags.
\[Story & Content] Polished scenes involving Cody, Emma, Emmette, Kyle, Lucy, MJ, Zoey, Zone, and Dexie.
\[Story & Content] Improved the flow of Dexie, PAris and Debora's character arcs. Their story can now be rewinded early on if you picked the wrong choice that locks you out of their route.

\[Story & Content] Added walkouts for characters that require correct donut orders to proceed with their stories, specifically Cody, Zone, Elias, PAris & Sam. This allows players to repeat their scenes until the correct donut is served.
\[Story & Content] Removed first meet choice requirement for Kyle to reach good end.
\[Story & Content] Emmette's friendship ending is now unlocked if you reject her in Chapter 22 - The Reunion (Romance).
\[Story & Content] Added additional dialogue and responses to several Zoey repeatable donut orders.
\[Story & Content] Added a backup loopable donut orders for all characters.
\[Story & Content] Fixed an issue where romance lines appear even when choosing not to date the 6 romanceables in their good end.
\[Story & Content] Improved more order dialogues across several characters so donut requests are clearer and more consistent.
\[Story & Content] Fixed several scene conditions and progression requirements.
\[Voice Acting] Added new voiced lines for Emma, Connor, and MJ.
\[Voice Acting] Updated or corrected several existing voice lines for Ainsley, Elias, JoJo, Kolt, MJ, Sally, Stacy, and Tiffany.
\[Decor App] Fixed decors occasionally applying incorrect customer appearance bonuses.
\[Decor App] Fixed anti-decors not reliably preventing affected customers from appearing.
\[Decor App] Fixed appearance rates not updating correctly after removing a decoration.
\ Updated several social-media images and references.
\ Fixed player names not being displayed correctly in Messenger previews.
\ Fixed long message previews not being trimmed consistently.
\ Opening the Backlog now stops Auto and Skip modes.
\ Fixed an issue that could cause story playback behavior to conflict with the Backlog.
\[Extras - Achievements] Fixed bankrupt achievement unlocking under the wrong conditions.
\[Extras - Achievements] Achievement for unlocking every Facenook post should now trigger.
\[Extras - Achievements] Fixed the unlock all achievements not triggering after every other achievement had been earned.
\[Extras - Chapters] Fixed progress displays for chapters that do not require relationship points.
\[Controller Support] Fixed controller navigation between Facenook timeline pages.
\[Controller Support] Fixed controller navigation and category selection in Hamazon.
\[Controller Support] Fixed jukebox items being assigned to the wrong controller-navigation group.
\[Controller Support] Fixed menus continuing to navigate while rebinding controller inputs.
\[General Fixes] Improved localization data across story scenes and recipes.
\[General Fixes] Various visual, progression, controller-navigation, and stability fixes.

items.text: Dear Mood Confectioners,

We just pushed out a patch for v1.0.5 today, which should fix several issues that were reported over the past days. It's a pretty long list, and we’re deeply grateful for your patience while our team worked through them.

We’re continuing to monitor the Steam forums and our Discord server, and while we may not be able to respond to every report, rest assured that we’re doing our best to resolve any new issues as quickly as possible. 🙏
\ Fixed a bug wherein some saves cannot be loaded after using the rewind feature. Your saves should be working now. We apologize for the inconvenience this bug has caused. 😭
\ Fixed several unclear or incorrect customer order instructions.
\ Fixed cooking hints appearing at the wrong time.
\ Recipes can now be opened during the drizzle tutorial.

\[Story & Content] Polished dialogues, scene presentations, character reactions, and order instructions across numerous routes. This is an ongoing process, and we'll continue to review and polish scenes in future patches as needed.
\[Story & Content] Added additional post-ending orders to the Extras menu for Stacy, Jojo, and Debora.
\[Story & Content] Fixed several story requirements and route conditions that could cause scenes or endings to unlock incorrectly.
\ Improved character tagging in posts and comments.
\ Fixed posts appearing in the wrong order.
\ Updated the friends list to display characters more reliably.
\ Added several missing posts and profile images.
\ Corrected profile information and various formatting issues.
\ Fixed multiple posts, comments, and interface inconsistencies.
\ Fixed emojis displaying incorrectly in message previews.
\ Fixed tagged character names in message previews.
\ Fixed an error that could occur while loading existing messages.
\ Fixed the Decor App tutorial becoming stuck or behaving incorrectly.
\ Fixed character appearance-rate information for decorations.
\ Fixed certain decoration preferences not being recognized correctly.
\ Improved the appearance-rate panel’s display and behavior.
\ Corrected the Tools category title in Hamazon.
\ Improved Jukebox behavior when the game loses or regains focus.
\ Fixed cases where Jukebox music could resume or stop incorrectly after switching away from the game.
\ Improved localization throughout the game.
\[General Fixes] Added missing assets used by several scenes and social media posts.
\[General Fixes] Fixed various visual, progression, localization, and data consistency issues.
\[General Fixes] Improved stability across story scenes, phone apps, and tutorials.
Last Wednesday (Aug 12), we released a patch for v1.0.4 but didn't post the patch notes here. Apologies for that. 😅 Here it is for everyone's reference:

\[Story & Content] Fixed several relationship/story progressions so certain supporting character storylines are correctly unlocking after finishing specific main-character scenes.
\[Art & Animation] Slightly improved Kyle's CG1 comic artwork.
\ Fixed the Decor app's info panel display.
\ Fixed the Decor app tutorial not behaving correctly.
\ Fixed the Hamazon shop tutorial getting stuck in some cases.
\ Fixed the Jukebox player crashing in certain situations.
\ Fixed some achievement stats not saving correctly.
\[General Fixes] Fixed a bug wherein it might cause a crash when loading a save game.
\[General Fixes] General stability improvements to reduce random errors.

notes.title: An easier way to get different endings

items.text: We see some players express concern about starting the game all over again if they didn't get the ending they wanted. The thing is, you don't have to! :3

There's a Rewind feature in Tender that unlocks once you have completed a character's story. A green, rewind button will appear and you can choose which specific part of that character's story you'd like to go back to. So if you only missed one option towards the end, you can just rewind back to that specific scene without restarting your entire progress.

items.text: Dear Mood Confectioners,
It's been a crazy 14 hours so far since release and we want to sincerely thank all of you who played the game and left a review! 🙏
We received a couple of bugs and addressed them as fast as we can. Please see the changes below:
Fixed a bug where powdered sugar donuts are often wrong.
Fixed a bug where tablets sometimes don't close after message.
Fixed a bug where Elisa scenes aren't triggering.
Fixed a bug where social media shows some pages beyond the amount of posts.
Fixed a bug where multiple message may be triggered everyday.
Fixed various localization bugs.
Fixed some achievements that aren't triggerable.
Fixed an issue where the video wont play in linux systems
Thank you so much and we hope this patch brings a smoother game experience! If you encounter anymore problems, please let us know via Discord or this forum thread. ːamyhappyː🍩
